passage: Honey bees communicate through dancing. When a worker bee finds a good patch of flowers, it returns to the hive and performs a 'waggle dance.' passage: Long before refrigerators, people preserved food using methods that sound surprising today. Salting drew moisture out of meat, depriving bacteria of the water they need to multiply.
